messages:
alex: Heads-up — while demoing the JS/Python sample apps I saw partial JSON fragments appear in the UI after I hit Ctrl+C to stop the client. Looks like orphaned SSE chunks getting flushed out of order.
marie: Ugh, that sounds like the same race we saw a while back but not quite the same failure mode. Can you paste the logs/snippet?
alex: Paste below. Happens reliably if you stop the client during an active stream within ~200-400ms of a token boundary.
```
[info] connected to /v1/streams
[debug] received chunk: "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":\" Hel\"
[debug] client SIGINT
[debug] flush buffer -> partial: "lo","}\n[warn] parser emitted: unexpected-eof
```
alex: UI shows {"choices":[{"delta":" Hel"} ... plus a trailing fragment which breaks JSON.parse in the sample app.
sam: Is this only on the JS sampleapp? Or repros in python too?
alex: Repros in both, but JS shows it in the browser console (JSON.parse error) and Python's sample app logs "incomplete final token". Suspect SDKs handle graceful shutdown differently: JS tries to reassemble buffered chunks, Python just writes whatever was in the socket.
ryan: Could be an auth/retry interplay: when auth refresh triggers near shutdown the server may send a final delimiter, client aborts mid-frame, then resume logic tries to replay last chunk and we get duplication/half-chunks.
marie: That matches user reports about "random JSON errors when stopping live demo". We should add a small repro harness and a recommended graceful shutdown in the sample apps. Short-term mitigation: ignore final incomplete JSON fragment on client parse and surface a clear message.
sam: Actionable checklist: 1) Add unit test in stream-parser for mid-chunk aborts. 2) Update JS sampleapp to buffer until a full SSE event (\n\n delimiter) before exposing data to JSON.parse. 3) Python sample: trim trailing partial token on shutdown. 4) Add an opt-in env var SAMPLEAPP_STRICT_STREAM=0 for demos to avoid crashing.
alex: I can open a tiny PR for the JS sample showing how to detect and drop partial events on 'beforeunload'/'SIGINT'. Proposal snippet: 
```
let pending = '';
esource.onmessage = (e) => { pending += e.data; if (pending.endsWith('\n\n')) { try { handle(JSON.parse(pending)); } catch(e){ console.warn('stream parse error, dropping chunk', e); } pending = ''; } }
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => { // flush safely
  pending = '';
});
```
marie: Nice — keep it small. Also add a comment about SDK parity: SDKs should document recommended shutdown semantics (flush vs drop) so demo apps behave the same.
ryan: I'll add a short integration test to the runtime repo that simulates auth refresh during streaming and client SIGINT to ensure we don't produce duplicate partial tokens.
deploy-bot: deploy status: no rolling deploys in dev cluster; can merge small PRs to main. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks — I'll open the PR and link this thread. If anyone wants to add a quick repro script (curl + sleep + SIGINTs) comment and I'll include it.
marie: Please tag me. Also file a small doc note in devex onboarding about "how to stop a demo without corrupting stream output". That should cut down support tickets. :memo:
